## Checklist

- [ ] Branched off `master` (not committing to `master` directly)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] Updated the relevant `docs/guide/` doc if I changed a module it maps to
- [ ] My change preserves the security invariants (local-only, no network egress,
      append-only audit ledger, policy-gated filesystem access — see CONTRIBUTING.md)
